decisionsTitle: The bib designer in named sections; the member mark, the profile from a picture or turned for the runner, labelled emergency phones
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-13**, of the bib designer «Cum arată numărul de concurs»: «Aici am nevoie de separatoare și iconițe, că nu mai înțeleg nimic...»; of the members' mark: «semnul BVR de pe număr trebuie să fie altceva, nu doar o bifă, o steluță, sau să aleg eu o iconiță»; of «Alocare și tipărire»: «nu înțeleg ce face butonul de „Alocă numerele”… îmi trebuie ceva tooltip pt el»; of the route's profile: «la profilul traseului pe număr ar trebui să pot alege dacă iau din Strava sau vreau poză, pt că nu pot să văd unde e punctul de alimentare pe acel număr», and of the distance and gain beside it: «aș vrea să bifez dacă vreau aceste elemente în dreapta sau nu, pt că dacă pun poză custom o să-mi apară mie ce vreau acolo»; from a photo of a trail race's bib: «I should also be able to rotate the race profile»; and of the emergency line: «pentru telefon în caz de urgențe trebuie să putem avea și un label». Amends §750 (the designer, the member mark, the profile's strip, the emergency phone) and §755 (the drawing's version).

**Decision — the designer in sections.** «Cum arată numărul de concurs» is six folds, top to bottom as the number prints: «Antet» (the band's colour — moved here from the race numbers' card, the same field —, the header's picture, the lockup, the race and its date, the distance badge), «Numărul» (its size, how it is written, the sheet's cut marks), «Numele» (whether and where), «Subsol și sponsori» (the sponsors' band and its place, the stubs, the small print), «Profilul și urgențele» (the route's profile and the emergency phones, the checkpoints' two ticks with them) and «Membrii». Each is a `Panel` of level 5 — a new level, an `h5` under the designer's `h4` — with its glyph and a closed line saying what it holds, closed until opened like every backoffice fold (§336); every field stays in the form while its fold is closed, so a save posts the whole design. Each picture place is a named sub-card: a bordered box with the place's glyph before its title, its one line of help, the buttons, and its «Calitate» row inside it, with a shorter line («Mare pentru sigle și text, Medie pentru fotografii.»). On a wide screen the preview stays in sight while the sections scroll under it. No field's name, no saved value and no behaviour changed by the move; the designer's e2e follows the moves.

**Decision — «Semnul de membru».** The mark §750 drew as a ring and a check becomes a choice under the same tick: «Steluță» (the default), «Sigla clubului», «Inimă», «Fulger», «Alergător», «Bifă». Each glyph is one SVG path in a 24-unit box (`bib-member-mark.ts`, copied from the Material icons the backoffice already draws: Star, Favorite, Bolt, DirectionsRun, CheckCircle); the sheet hands the very string to pdfkit's own path reader, scaled into the mark's box and filled in the number's ink, and the picture draws it in an inline SVG — one source, so the paper and the preview cannot differ. The logo is the club's blue lockup (`src/theme/pdf/logo.png`, the same file both renderers read), never recoloured (§711): as tall as the star and as wide as its proportion, the name above the number stepping aside by that width; on a member's card drawn «Tot numărul» its own white ground is its plate. The editor's radios show each mark drawn from the same path. Because a member's number that printed the ring now prints the star, `BIB_DRAWING_VERSION` goes to 3 and every stamped picture address changes.

**Decision — «Alocă numerele» explained.** The button carries a tooltip in plain words — it gives a number to every real, confirmed registration that has none yet, in order of confirmation, from the race's first number; nobody who has one gets another; numbers come by themselves at confirmation, so it catches up on registrations confirmed before numbers existed or after the first number changed; test registrations get none — and the same words behind a «?» a thumb can tap. «De la» and «Până la» belong to the PDF, not to the allocation: they sit under their own heading «Tipărește doar numerele de la … până la …», beside the two download buttons, a divider above them; the sheet's GET form is unchanged.

**Decision — the profile from the GPX or a picture.** «De unde vine profilul»: «Desenat din traseul evenimentului (GPX)» (the default, §750's strip) or «O poză încărcată» — the house's picture control, the same upload, gallery, size and type limits as the header's, stored in the design as `profileImageSrc` and fitted whole in the strip, never cropped, in the sheet and the picture alike. The strip is drawn from the event's GPX file, not from Strava: Strava's embed cannot be read by the server, and the editor says so. The checkpoints' marks are drawn on the GPX's line only — on a picture the club drew what it wanted — so their two ticks show with that source and the checkpoints are not read for a picture. Without a GPX the profile's tick is no longer greyed: a picture needs none, and the GPX choice says to upload one or choose a picture.

**Decision — the figures beside it, on or off.** «Arată distanța și diferența de nivel lângă profil», on by default: the two lines at the strip's right as §750 drew them — the club's typed figures first, the GPX's where the club left them empty, and for a picture only what is known. Off, or nothing to say beside a picture, and the chart or the picture takes the strip's whole width; the checkpoints' crowding rule measures in that width.

**Decision — the profile turned for the runner.** «Orientarea profilului»: «Normal» (the default) or «Întors, ca să-l citească alergătorul», half a circle, the figures and the checkpoints' marks turning with it. When the emergency phone is printed upside down too («Tipărit invers», §750, on by default), the profile and the phone are **one** turned block, as in the owner's trail example: turned about the block's own centre, the phone comes out above the profile on the paper and reads right under it for the runner looking down. Otherwise each row turns alone. The sponsors stay the right way up at the foot. Decided once (`bibExtrasTurn`), drawn by pdfkit's `rotate` and the picture's `rotate(180deg)` at the same points.

**Decision — the phone's label and a second number.** «Eticheta telefonului» (at most 40 characters) is printed before the numbers; empty, the platform's word in the sheet's language («Urgențe» / "Emergency"), so nothing changes until the club types one. It follows the club's footer line and the members' label: one plain line in one text for every language, normalised to what the bib's font can draw. Up to two numbers, each checked as a telephone like the first always was, each with its own optional label (at most 24 characters: a name or a role), on one line: «Urgențe: Coordonator 07xx xxx xxx / Medic 07yy yyy yyy». A line too long for the card shrinks from 9 points to 6.5 and only past that is cut with «…» (`bibEmergencyFit`). Always the organizers' numbers, never a runner's own contact.

**Every new key** — `profileSource`, `profileImageSrc`, `showProfileFigures`, `profileOrientation`, `emergencyLabel`, `emergencyPhoneLabel`, `emergencyPhone2`, `emergencyPhone2Label`, `member.markShape` — lives in the design's JSON column, so no migration: a design saved before reads the defaults and prints as it did, the member mark aside. Each travels in the preview's address, changes the bibs page's picture stamp and the desk's SQL stamp (both hash the whole design), has its label in the event file's `FIELD_LABELS` and both catalogues; the profile's picture is a medium of the event file (`bib.profile`).

**Refused.** Moving the member mark into «Numărul»: it is the members' and shows only with their number. Cropping the profile's picture: its box changes with the figures' tick, and the owner's ask was a picture of his own as it is. Turning the phone and the profile in one tick: the phone's own «Tipărit invers» stays, and the block forms when both are turned. A label per language for the phone: the club's other typed lines on the bib are one text.
changelogLine: - **The bib designer in sections, with a profile picture, a turned profile and labelled emergency phones** — «Cum arată numărul de concurs» is six named folds top to bottom as the number prints, each picture place a sub-card with its quality row; the member mark is a star by default, the club's logo or a glyph; «Alocă numerele» explains itself and the print range sits by the PDF buttons; the route's profile comes from the GPX or an uploaded picture, with or without the distance and gain beside it, and can be turned for the runner together with the emergency phone, which takes a label and a second number. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the event editor's bib designer, when it renders, then its settings are six named folds with a glyph and a closed line, top to bottom as the number prints — «Antet», «Numărul», «Numele», «Subsol și sponsori», «Profilul și urgențele», «Membrii» — each field in the section it prints in and each picture place a named sub-card with its «Calitate» row inside it; no field's name or saved value changes (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a member's number with «Semn de membru pe număr» ticked, when it prints or is previewed, then it carries the chosen mark — «Steluță» by default, the club's logo in its own blue, or a heart, a bolt, a runner or a check — the sheet drawing each glyph from the same SVG path the picture draws, and a design saved before the choice reads the star (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Alocare și tipărire», when it renders for an Administrator, then «Alocă numerele» carries in plain words, on hover and behind a «?», what it does — every real, confirmed registration without a number gets one, in order of confirmation, nobody gets a second, test registrations none — and «De la» / «Până la» sit under their own heading beside the PDF buttons, posting to the sheet's form (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a design with the route's profile, when the club chooses «O poză încărcată», then the stored picture is fitted whole in the profile's strip on the sheet and in the picture, with no checkpoint marks; with «Arată distanța și diferența de nivel lângă profil» off, or nothing to say beside a picture, the drawn profile or the picture takes the strip's whole width (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Orientarea profilului» set to «Întors, ca să-l citească alergătorul», when the number prints, then the profile, its figures and its marks are turned half a circle; with the emergency phone printed upside down too, the two are one block turned about its own centre, in the sheet and in the picture (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the emergency phone, when the club types «Eticheta telefonului» and up to two numbers, each with its own label, then one line prints «label: name number / name number», each number checked as a telephone, the platform's word when no label is typed, shrunk to fit the card before anything is cut (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given any of the design's new keys, when it changes, then the preview's address, the bibs page's picture stamp and the desk's stamp change with it, the event file labels it, and `BIB_DRAWING_VERSION` 3 gives every existing number a new address (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the bib designer in sections, with a profile picture, a turned profile and labelled emergency phones
